UN R3.scope_evidence: This Regulation applies to retro-reflecting devices for vehicles of categories L, M, N, O, and T
UN R3.reason: Although M1 is within scope, the specified bumper integrates only active LED front fog lamps, front direction indicators and ultrasonic sensors. No retro-reflector (reflex reflector) is listed among its parts or functions, so no device approved by R3 is part of the product.

UN R6.scope_evidence: This Regulation applies to direction indicators for vehicles of categories L, M, N, O, and T.
UN R6.reason: The bumper integrates LED front direction indicator lamps, which are devices type-approved under UN R6 (e.g. category 1/1a/1b front indicators) for M1 vehicles. These lamps must meet R6 requirements on intensity, light distribution, colour and marking.

UN R7.scope_evidence: "Front and rear position lamps, stop-lamps and end-outline marker lamps of different type" means lamps which differ in such essential respects as...
UN R7.reason: UN R7 approves only position lamps, stop lamps and end-outline marker lamps. The bumper's integrated lamps are front fog lamps and direction indicators, which other regulations cover, and the specification does not mention any position or end-outline lamp.

UN R10.scope_evidence: Components and separate technical units intended to be fitted in these vehicles with the limitation given in paragraph 3.2.1. with regard to electromagnetic compatibility.
UN R10.reason: The bumper integrates electronic sub-assemblies (LED fog and indicator lamps, ultrasonic parking sensors) for M1 vehicles, which are ESAs subject to R10 emission and immunity requirements. The direction indicators also relate to signalling to other road users, which is an immunity-related function.

UN R13H.scope_evidence: This Regulation applies to the braking of vehicles of categories M1 and N1.
UN R13H.reason: R13H approves the braking system of M1/N1 vehicles. The front bumper, its lamps and its parking sensors are not part of the braking system and do not determine braking performance. The mentions about wiring, sensors and lights refer only to braking-system components.

UN R19.scope_evidence: This Regulation applies to front fog lamps, which may incorporate lenses of glass or plastic material.
UN R19.reason: The bumper integrates LED front fog lamps with PC lenses. These are exactly the device type that UN R19 approves, so the fog lamps need R19 approval (Class F3 permits LED modules).

UN R23.scope_evidence: "Reversing/manoeuvring lamps of different types" means lamps which differ in such essential respects as...
UN R23.reason: UN R23 approves reversing and manoeuvring lamps only. The front bumper contains front fog lamps and front direction indicators, neither of which is a reversing or manoeuvring lamp, so none of its functions fall within this regulation.

UN R26.scope_evidence: This Regulation applies to external projections of category M1 vehicles. ... 6.5 Bumpers; 6.3 Grilles and gaps
UN R26.reason: R26 approves the external projections of M1 vehicles and contains dedicated provisions for bumpers (6.5, including bumper ends and bumper cover) and grilles (6.3). The front bumper of an M1 car must therefore meet these requirements, although the lamps and sensors are not covered beyond the general exterior provisions.

UN R32.scope_evidence: "approval of a vehicle" means the approval of a vehicle type with regard to the behaviour of the structure of the passenger compartment in a rear-end collision
UN R32.reason: UN R32 approves the M1 vehicle for passenger compartment behaviour in a rear-end collision, using an impactor striking the rear of the vehicle. A front bumper assembly plays no part in that system or test.

UN R37.scope_evidence: This Regulation applies to filament light sources and their LED replacement light sources shown in Annex 1 and intended for use in approved lamps
UN R37.reason: The bumper's fog lamps and direction indicators are specified as LED lamps, so they contain no filament light sources or LED replacement bulbs that R37 approves. R37 approves replaceable light sources, not the lamps themselves, which fall under other lighting regulations.

UN R38.scope_evidence: "Rear fog lamps of different types" means lamps which differ in such essential respects as...
UN R38.reason: UN R38 approves rear fog lamps only. The bumper has front fog lamps and front direction indicators, which this regulation does not cover.

UN R39.scope_evidence: This Regulation applies to the approval of vehicles of categories L, M and N with regard to speedometer and odometer
UN R39.reason: UN R39 concerns speedometer and odometer equipment. No function or part of the front bumper (impact structure, lamps, parking sensors) determines speed or distance indication, so the regulation does not apply.

UN R40.scope_evidence: This Regulation applies to the emission of gaseous pollutants from positive-ignition engines of vehicles of categories L3, L4 and L5.
UN R40.reason: UN R40 covers exhaust emissions of positive-ignition engines in motorcycles (L3, L4, L5). It does not cover M1 vehicles or bumpers, lamps or parking sensors.

UN R42.scope_evidence: This Regulation applies to vehicles of category M1 with regard to the behaviour of their front and rear protective devices when involved in a collision at low speed.
UN R42.reason: The front bumper is the M1 front protective device whose low-speed impact behaviour R42 approves, so its beam, absorber, cover and mountings directly determine compliance. The lamps and parking sensors are not covered: the requirement that other systems keep working after the test does not make R42 apply to them, and sensors of driver-assist systems are explicitly excluded.

UN R43.scope_evidence: to the exclusion of: (i) Glazing for lighting and light-signalling devices
UN R43.reason: The front bumper has no windscreen, pane or partition glazing. Its only transparent parts are the lamp lenses, and glazing for lighting and light-signalling devices is explicitly excluded from R43's scope.

UN R48.scope_evidence: This Regulation applies to vehicles of categories M, N, and to their trailers (category O) with regard to the installation of lighting and light-signalling devices.
UN R48.reason: The bumper integrates front fog lamps and front direction indicators on an M1 vehicle. R48 sets installation requirements for these lamps (position, mounting height, spacing, geometric visibility, colour and switching, e.g. 6.5 for direction indicators), and the bumper design determines whether they are met.

UN R49.scope_evidence: This Regulation shall apply to motor vehicles of categories M1, M2, N1 and N2 with a reference mass exceeding 2,610 kg ... emissions of C.I. and P.I. engines
UN R49.reason: UN R49 regulates pollutant emissions from heavy-duty engines and vehicles. A front bumper assembly with its lamps and parking sensors does not determine engine emissions, so the regulation concerns other systems.

UN R51.scope_evidence: This Regulation contains provisions on the sound emitted by motor vehicles and applies to vehicles of categories M and N.
UN R51.reason: UN R51 approves vehicles for exterior sound emission (powertrain, exhaust, tyres). It has no provisions for bumpers, lamps or parking sensors. The mentions of 'parking brake' and 'obstacle' are unrelated to this product.

UN R53.scope_evidence: This Regulation applies to vehicles of category L3 with regard to the installation of lighting and light-signalling devices.
UN R53.reason: UN R53 covers lamp installation only on L3 motorcycles. This bumper is for M1 passenger cars, so the vehicle category is outside the scope, even though the bumper contains fog lamps and direction indicators.

UN R62.scope_evidence: This Regulation applies to vehicles of categories L1 to L7, if fitted with handlebars.
UN R62.reason: UN R62 covers anti-theft protective devices for handlebar-equipped L-category vehicles. The product is a front bumper for M1 passenger cars and contains no anti-theft device.

UN R64.scope_evidence: This Regulation applies to the approval of vehicles of category M1 and N1 when equipped with: (a) A temporary use spare unit; and/or (b) Run-flat tyres and/or a run-flat system
UN R64.reason: UN R64 covers temporary-use spare units, run-flat tyres/systems and run-flat warning systems. The front bumper assembly contains none of these. The sensor and electrical mentions refer only to the run-flat warning system, not to parking sensors or lamps.

UN R67.scope_evidence: Approval of specific equipment of vehicles of category M and N1 using liquefied petroleum gases in their propulsion system
UN R67.reason: R67 covers LPG fuel system components and their installation; a front bumper assembly with lamps and parking sensors contains no LPG equipment. The mentions concern hose couplings, containers and LPG wiring, not bumper parts.

UN R79.scope_evidence: This Regulation applies to the steering equipment of vehicles of Categories M, N and O.
UN R79.reason: R79 approves steering equipment; the front bumper with lamps and parking sensors is not part of the steering system. The mentions of direction indicators and sensors concern ACSF lane-change logic and turning-circle definitions, and impose no requirements on the bumper, its lamps or its parking sensors.

UN R83.scope_evidence: type approval of motor vehicles with regard to crankcase emissions (Type 3 test) and exhaust emissions at low ambient temperature (Type 6 test)
UN R83.reason: R83 approves M1/N1 vehicles for emissions, in-service conformity, anti-tampering and related monitoring. A front bumper with lamps and parking sensors does not determine emissions performance, and the regulation's mentions of 'sensors' refer to emissions and energy data integrity, not parking sensors.

UN R89.scope_evidence: to limit the road speed of vehicles by means of a vehicle system which has the primary function of controlling the fuel feed to the engine or via the engine management
UN R89.reason: UN R89 covers speed limitation devices (SLD/ASLD) and their installation, which are engine or fuel-feed control systems. The front bumper's impact protection, lamps and parking sensors have no part in limiting vehicle speed.

UN R92.scope_evidence: applies to non-original replacement exhaust silencing systems for vehicles of categories L1, L2, L3, L4 and L5
UN R92.reason: R92 covers replacement exhaust silencers for L-category vehicles. The product is an M1 front bumper with no exhaust silencing function, so both the vehicle category and the system type fall outside the scope.

UN R94.scope_evidence: This Regulation applies to vehicles of category M1 of a total permissible mass not exceeding 2,500 kg; vehicle type differs in … the length and width of the vehicle … (structure forward of the driver's seat)
UN R94.reason: R94 approves the M1 vehicle's occupant protection in a frontal offset crash. The bumper beam, bolted to the crash boxes, is part of the front-end load path that affects crash energy management, but the shown provisions contain no bumper-specific requirements. Applicability therefore depends on how much the beam contributes to the vehicle's frontal crash performance.

UN R100.scope_evidence: Safety requirements with respect to the electric power train of road vehicles ... equipped with electric power train
UN R100.reason: UN R100 covers the high-voltage electric power train and REESS of electric vehicles. A front bumper with low-voltage lamps and parking sensors is not part of the electric power train, so the regulation sets no requirements for it.

UN R101.scope_evidence: applies to vehicles of categories M1 and N1 with regard to: (a) the measurement of the emission of carbon dioxide (CO2) and fuel consumption and/or ... electric energy consumption and electric range
UN R101.reason: R101 approves the whole vehicle's CO2, fuel consumption and electric range measurement. It has no dedicated provisions for bumpers, fog lamps, direction indicators or parking sensors. The bumper only indirectly affects road load and aerodynamics, which is a general vehicle property, so the regulation does not set requirements for this component.

UN R102.scope_evidence: This Regulation applies to vehicles of categories N2, N3, O3 and O4.
UN R102.reason: UN R102 covers close-coupling devices between towing vehicles and trailers of categories N2, N3, O3 and O4. The product is a front bumper for M1 passenger cars and contains no close-coupling device.

UN R103.scope_evidence: type-approval, as separate technical units, of pollution control device ... Catalytic converters and particulate filters shall be considered to be pollution control devices
UN R103.reason: UN R103 covers only replacement catalytic converters and particulate filters in the exhaust line. The front bumper assembly contains no such pollution control device, and the regulation's mentions of sensors refer to exhaust oxygen probes, not parking sensors.

UN R104.scope_evidence: This Regulation applies to retro-reflective markings for vehicles of category M2, M3, N, O2, O3 and O4.
UN R104.reason: R104 does not cover M1 vehicles, and the bumper has no retro-reflective marking material. Its lamps and sensors fall under other regulations.

UN R107.scope_evidence: This Regulation applies to every single-deck, double-deck, rigid or articulated vehicle of category M2 or M3.
UN R107.reason: UN R107 covers the general construction of buses and coaches (M2/M3). This front bumper is for M1 passenger cars only, so the regulation's scope excludes it.

UN R114.scope_evidence: This Regulation applies to the following aftermarket equipment: to airbag modules for replacement airbag systems ... replacement steering wheels ... replacement airbag systems
UN R114.reason: UN R114 covers aftermarket replacement airbag modules, steering wheels and airbag systems for occupant restraint. The front bumper has no airbag. Its mentions of direction indicators and wiring harness refer only to steering-wheel tell-tales and airbag wiring.

UN R116.scope_evidence: Approval of a vehicle of category M1 and N1 with regard to its devices to prevent unauthorized use ... vehicle alarm systems (VAS) ... immobilizers
UN R116.reason: R116 approves anti-theft devices, alarm systems and immobilizers, none of which the bumper provides. The alarm system may flash the direction indicators, but that is a requirement on the alarm's signalling, not on the indicator lamps themselves.

UN R123.scope_evidence: This Regulation applies to adaptive front-lighting systems (AFS) for motor vehicles of categories M and N1.
UN R123.reason: The bumper integrates front fog lamps and direction indicators, but no headlamps or adaptive passing/driving beam system. AFS approval under R123 concerns passing- and driving-beam systems, which the product does not provide. The front direction indicators are mentioned only as possibly grouped lamps in approval-mark examples, which does not bring them under R123's scope.

UN R127.scope_evidence: This Regulation applies to motor vehicles of categories M1 and N1; "Bumper test area" means either the front vehicle fascia between the left and right corner of bumper
UN R127.reason: R127 approves M1 vehicles for pedestrian protection, with dedicated bumper provisions (bumper beam, bumper test area, lower legform tests). The bumper's fascia, EPP absorber and beam directly determine the lower-leg impact results.

UN R128.scope_evidence: This Regulation applies to LED light sources shown in Annex 1 and intended for use in approved lamps of power- driven vehicles
UN R128.reason: The integrated LED fog lamps and direction indicators would fall under R128 only if they use replaceable LED light sources of an Annex 1 category. The specification does not say whether they use such light sources or non-replaceable LED modules, which R128 does not cover.

UN R131.scope_evidence: This Regulation applies to the approval of vehicles of Category M2, M3, N2 and N3 with regard to an on-board system to: (a) Avoid or mitigate the severity of a rear-end in lane collision
UN R131.reason: R131 approves AEBS on heavy vehicle categories M2, M3, N2 and N3 only, so the product's M1 category is outside its scope. The bumper's ultrasonic parking sensors are also not part of an AEBS.

UN R132.scope_evidence: This Regulation applies to Retrofit Emission Control devices (REC) to be installed: On category M2, M3 and N vehicles and their CI engines
UN R132.reason: R132 covers retrofit exhaust emission control devices for CI engines in M2, M3, N, T vehicles and non-road machinery. It does not cover M1 front bumpers, lamps or parking sensors.

UN R137.scope_evidence: "Vehicle type" means a category of power-driven vehicles which do not differ in such essential respects, in so far as they have an adverse effect on the result of the impact test prescribed in this Regulation, as: (a) The length and width of the vehicle; (b) T...
UN R137.reason: R137 approves M1 vehicles for occupant restraint in a full-width rigid-barrier frontal impact. The front structure, including the bumper beam bolted to the crash boxes, can influence the crash pulse and the vehicle-type definition. However, the regulation has no bumper-specific provisions and mainly concerns the restraint system, so its relevance to this bumper is uncertain.

UN R148.scope_evidence: This Regulation applies to the following light-signalling devices (lamps): ... Direction indicator lamps
UN R148.reason: The bumper integrates front direction indicator lamps, which are a device type approved under R148 (Table 1 lists 'Front direction indicator lamp 1, 1a, 1b...'). Front fog lamps are not in R148's scope, since they are covered by R149, and R148 does not cover the parking sensors or the bumper structure.

UN R149.scope_evidence: This Regulation applies to the following road illumination devices (lamps): ... Front fog lamps for vehicles of categories L3, L4, L5, L7, M, N and T
UN R149.reason: The bumper integrates LED front fog lamps for an M1 vehicle, and front fog lamps for category M vehicles are a device type approved under R149. The direction indicators and other bumper functions are not covered by this regulation.

UN R150.scope_evidence: This Regulation applies to retro-reflective devices as: • Retro-reflectors of the Classes IA, IB, IIIA, IIIB and IVA • Retro-reflective Marking Materials ... • Advance Warning Triangles
UN R150.reason: The bumper contains fog lamps, direction indicators and parking sensors, but no retro-reflectors or retro-reflective marking are listed among its parts or functions. R150 approves only retro-reflective devices, so it does not apply unless a front retro-reflector were added to the bumper.

UN R152.scope_evidence: applies to the approval of vehicles of Category M1 and N1 with regard to an on-board system to (a) Avoid or mitigate the severity of a rear-end in lane collision...
UN R152.reason: R152 approves the vehicle's Advanced Emergency Braking System, which detects imminent forward collisions and brakes automatically. The bumper's ultrasonic sensors serve only parking assistance, and the specification names no AEBS radar or camera in the bumper, so the product does not determine AEBS performance.

functions_covered: parking-assist obstacle detection (ultrasonic sensors interfacing with the parking-assist control unit)
wiring harness / electrical interfaces to vehicle electronics
UN R155.scope_evidence: This Regulation applies to vehicles, with regard to cyber security, of the Categories M and N.
UN R155.reason: R155 approves the whole M1 vehicle type for cyber security, not components. The bumper's ultrasonic sensors and lamps connect to vehicle control units, so they may fall within the vehicle manufacturer's risk assessment and supply-chain requirements, but the passive mechanical parts are not affected and it is unclear whether the sensors communicate digitally.

functions_covered: parking-assist obstacle detection (ultrasonic sensors, if they carry updatable software/firmware)
UN R156.scope_evidence: This Regulation applies to vehicles of Categories M, N, O, R, S and T that permit software updates.
UN R156.reason: R156 approves the vehicle and the manufacturer's software update management system, not hardware components such as the bumper structure or lamps. It would only reach this product if the ultrasonic sensors (or other electronics) contain software updatable within the vehicle, which the specification does not state.

UN R157.scope_evidence: This Regulation applies to the type approval of vehicles of Category M and N1 with regards to their Automated Lane Keeping System.
UN R157.reason: R157 approves vehicles for their ALKS. The bumper's ultrasonic parking sensors serve low-speed parking assistance, not ALKS environment sensing. Mentions of direction indicators only concern how the ALKS activates existing lamps, which does not make the regulation apply to the lamps themselves.

UN R161.scope_evidence: Approval of a vehicle of category M1 and N1 with regard to its devices to prevent unauthorized use.
UN R161.reason: R161 covers anti-theft devices such as steering, gearbox and immobiliser locking. The front bumper's functions (impact absorption, styling, lamps, parking sensors) include no device to prevent unauthorized use, so the regulation concerns other systems.

UN R162.scope_evidence: Approval of immobilizers which are intended to be permanently fitted to vehicles ... Approval of vehicles of category M1 ... with regard to their immobilizer(s).
UN R162.reason: The front bumper contains no immobilizer function or component. The use of direction indicators as an optional immobilizer status signal only constrains the immobilizer, not the lamps themselves.

UN R163.scope_evidence: Approval of Vehicle Alarm Systems (VAS) which are intended to be permanently fitted to vehicles of any category... Approval of vehicles of category M1... with regard to their alarm system(s).
UN R163.reason: R163 approves vehicle alarm systems, and the bumper contains no alarm control unit, sensor or siren. The mentions of direction indicators only allow the alarm to flash the vehicle's existing lamps as an optical signal; they set no requirements for the bumper's lamps, sensors or structure.

UN R164.scope_evidence: This Regulation applies to new studded pneumatic tyres of Classes C1, C2 and C3 with regard to their snow performance.
UN R164.reason: UN R164 covers only studded tyres and their snow performance. The front bumper assembly contains no tyres, and the regulation does not concern any of its functions or parts.

UN R171.scope_evidence: applies to the type approval of vehicles of Categories M and N2 with regard to their Driver Control Assistance Systems (DCAS)
UN R171.reason: R171 approves vehicles for DCAS, which provides sustained longitudinal and lateral driving assistance. The bumper's ultrasonic parking-assist sensors are not part of such a system. The direction indicators are only activated by DCAS during manoeuvres, which places no requirements on the lamps themselves.

UN R174.scope_evidence: This Regulation applies to all seating positions in vehicles of categories M and N fitted with safety belt with regard to safety-belt reminders.
UN R174.reason: R174 concerns safety-belt reminder systems for seating positions. A front bumper assembly, including its lamps and parking sensors, has no role in belt reminders.

UN R175.scope_evidence: applies to the type approval of vehicles of Category M1 equipped with automatic transmission with regard to their Acceleration Control for Pedal Error systems (ACPE)... means of forward and/or rear detection
UN R175.reason: ACPE must detect obstacles 1.0–1.5 m in front of the vehicle, and the bumper's front ultrasonic sensors are a typical forward-detection means, so they could determine ACPE performance. The specification does not say whether the vehicle has ACPE or automatic transmission, or whether these parking-assist sensors feed it, so applicability is uncertain.

UN GTR 9.scope_evidence: This global technical regulation (gtr) shall apply to the frontal surfaces of power driven vehicles of category 1-1 with a gross vehicle mass exceeding 500 kg
UN GTR 9.reason: GTR 9 governs the pedestrian protection performance of the vehicle front, including dedicated bumper provisions: a bumper test area, a bumper beam definition and lower legform impact tests. The front bumper's EPP absorber, beam and fascia directly determine lower-leg impact results for M1 (category 1-1) vehicles.

GTR 9 is a global technical regulation under the 1998 Agreement, not a UN Regulation for type approval. Its pedestrian bumper and lower-legform provisions are transposed into UN R127, which is kept. Citing both would duplicate the same lower-leg requirements, so R127 is cited instead.

UN R10.reason: The bumper contains electronic sub-assemblies: LED fog lamps, LED direction indicators, ultrasonic parking sensors and their harness. These are ESAs subject to R10 emission and immunity requirements for M1 vehicles.

UN R127.reason: R127 approves M1 vehicles for pedestrian protection. It has dedicated bumper provisions (bumper test area, bumper beam definition, lower legform impact). The fascia, EPP absorber and beam directly determine the result.

UN R128.reason: R128 applies only to replaceable LED light sources of Annex 1 categories. The specification describes integrated LED lamps and gives no indication of replaceable R128 light sources, so including it would rest on an unsupported assumption.

UN R137.reason: R137 approves the occupant restraint system in a full-width frontal impact. It has no bumper-specific provisions, and the beam's influence on the crash pulse is indirect, so it concerns another vehicle system.

UN R148.reason: The bumper integrates front direction indicator lamps, a device type approved under R148, which replaces R6. R148 sets photometric, colour and other device requirements for these lamps.

UN R149.reason: The bumper integrates front fog lamps for an M1 vehicle, a device type approved under R149, which replaces R19. R149 sets photometric and other device requirements for these lamps.

UN R155.reason: R155 is a vehicle-level cyber security and CSMS approval with no component provisions. Any link via the parking sensors is speculative, since digital communication is not stated.

UN R156.reason: R156 is a vehicle-level software update management approval. Updatable software in the sensors or lamps is not stated, so the link is speculative.

UN R175.reason: R175 applies only if the vehicle has ACPE with automatic transmission and the parking sensors feed that system. None of this is stated, so the link is speculative and concerns another vehicle system.

UN R26.reason: R26 governs the external projections of M1 vehicles. It contains dedicated provisions for bumpers (6.5) and grilles (6.3), which apply directly to the fascia, bumper ends and lower grille.

UN R42.reason: R42 approves the low-speed collision behaviour of the M1 front protective device, which is this bumper. The beam, absorber, cover and mountings determine compliance.

UN R48.reason: R48 is the installation regulation listing front fog lamps and front direction indicators. The bumper determines their mounting height, spacing, geometric visibility and orientation.

UN R94.reason: R94 is a whole-vehicle frontal offset occupant protection approval with no bumper-specific provisions. The beam's contribution to the load path is indirect and concerns the vehicle structure and restraint systems.
